newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on settlement day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks eased towards the close of trading on Monday, with blue chips down on position-squaring by speculators on settlement day. Dealers said, however, they saw the index holding range bound near term.

The Karachi 100-share index fell 5.50 points, or 0.37 percent, to end at 1,477.13 from 1,485.03 at noon. Losers led gainers 131 to 129. "Trading remained erratic today. Initially the index was up on blue chips but selling in the GDR (Global Depositary Reciept) linked issues and position-squaring pulled it down," dealer Ambreen Shoukat said. Dewan Salman Fibres fell 0.90 rupees to 30.70. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
